status: frozen; a definition never changes in place. Adding a metric is 1.1.0; changing a numerator, denominator, eligibility, window, filter or unit is 2.0.0 and the baseline is recomputed under both versions for one overlap period

measurement_contract.location: private measurement store (not in this repository); this dictionary carries definitions only, never measured values

code: web-analytics skill scripts/traffic_quality.py (filtered tier, referral arrivals)
derived_from.plan_of_record: intent-os 000-docs/228 (S03, S04, S07; section 2 'The number at the top')

tiers.headline: suspected-automation classes A1, S1, S2 removed (the filtered tier)
tiers.strict: headline plus the N1 and N2 clusters

clock.window_form: [D1 00:00, D2 00:00) local; the Umami query sends endAt = ms(D2) - 1 because its range is inclusive at both ends
clock.fully_observed: D1 >= the property's verified collection start and D2 <= the first day still incomplete at query time

units.session: one distinct Umami session id inside one query window. Umami labels this 'visitors'; it is NOT a person. The id is a salted hash whose salt rotates monthly, so sessions are never summed across months and never called people, readers or visitors
units.pageview: one recorded page load inside the window
units.event_session: one session with at least one matching custom event; an event is an attempt (a click), not an outcome
units.exception: one open critical exception in the recovery evidence matrix
units.day: calendar day in the report clock
units.devto_page_view: Dev.to-reported lifetime page views for one article (platform unit, cumulative, not a session, never added to site sessions)

value_states.measured: a number the query returned, including a measured 0
value_states.zero: a measured 0. Only a successful query over a fully observed, eligible window can produce it
value_states.unavailable: the query or collector failed. Never printed as 0
value_states.unknown: the quantity exists but nothing records it (for example native reads on X, LinkedIn, Substack, Medium, Hashnode). Never printed as 0
value_states.n/a: not eligible: the window is not fully observed, the denominator is below its floor, or the two sides of a comparison do not share one definition. Never printed as 0
value_states.untagged: a referral surface whose links carry no tag yet: 'untagged - unmeasurable', never 0
value_states.unverified_placement: a placement with no publication receipt: never counted as published and never 0

allowed_only_when: both sides use the same metric id and dictionary major version
both sides use the same filter rule version and tier
both sides use the same unit and the same denominator definition
both windows are fully observed for every member of the population being compared
the population (site set, post cohort) is identical on both sides
comparison_rule.otherwise: n/a, with the reason. A comparison that changes its denominator is never printed as a percentage change

replaced_comparisons.was: year-over-year and year-to-date change against a prior-year window that predates verified collection
replaced_comparisons.now: n/a until the prior window is fully observed

replaced_comparisons.was: week-over-week change on the all-registry total across the 2026-09-24 registry growth
replaced_comparisons.now: n/a until both windows start on or after the registry's complete-since date; the fixed four-site cohort carries the comparable trend

replaced_comparisons.was: a 7-day statistic over one post cohort beside a 28-day statistic over a smaller cohort
replaced_comparisons.now: paired cohort: both windows observed for every post

replaced_comparisons.was: per-placement arrival rates compared with per-post session rates
replaced_comparisons.now: separate metrics with separate denominators; never compared

replaced_comparisons.was: filtered counts under rule v1 compared with counts under rule v2
replaced_comparisons.now: one rule version per comparison; a rule change is a baseline reset

replaced_comparisons.was: native platform views added to, or set as a share of, site sessions
replaced_comparisons.now: native panels in their own unit, never summed with site sessions

recovery_open_critical_exceptions.label: Open critical exceptions, with the age of the oldest
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.role: recovery headline (the number at the top while recovery runs)
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.unit: exception (count) and day (age of the oldest)
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.numerator: critical exceptions in the recovery evidence matrix whose state is open (a documented exception is not a completed repair)
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.denominator: none (count); companion value: age in whole days of the oldest open critical exception at report time
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.eligibility: every critical exception recorded in the evidence matrix, whatever its epic
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.window: point in time: the report date, 00:00 report clock
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.n_a: evidence matrix unreadable -> unavailable, never 0 open; zero open exceptions -> age is n/a, not 0
recovery_open_critical_exceptions.never: a closed exception without linked evidence is still open

pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.label: Search-referred filtered sessions per pilot article, first 28 days
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.numerator: distinct headline-tier sessions with at least one pageview of the article's own path whose referrer domain is a listed search engine, in the article's window
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.denominator: one pilot article (a per-article count, compared with the frozen baseline distribution of the pilot host)
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.eligibility: pilot article on its canonical host; launch is the later of the front-matter date and the first-add commit date; the +28-day window fully observed
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.window: [launch, launch + 28 days) in the report clock
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.filter_version: 2026-10-03.v2, headline tier (search-referred sessions carry a referrer, so raw equals headline under v2)
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.n_a: window not yet fully observed -> n/a (immature), never 0; host property unavailable -> unavailable
pilot_search_referred_sessions_first_28d.never: LLM-assistant referrals are a separate column and are never added to search

pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.label: Outbound clicks to the demonstrated resource per 100 filtered article sessions
pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.numerator: distinct eligible article sessions with at least one outbound_click whose destination equals the article's named resource
pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.denominator: distinct eligible article sessions: headline tier, at least one pageview on the article path, known test sessions excluded
pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.eligibility: windows starting on or after 2026-10-04 (first full day after event reception was verified)
pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.window: the same [launch, launch + 28 days) window as the primary
pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.n_a: denominator below 20 -> report numerator/denominator with no rate; window before 2026-10-04 -> n/a
pilot_reader_action_rate_per_100.never: a click is an attempt, not a visit, install, download, subscription, accepted inquiry or revenue

monthly_sessions.label: Monthly sessions
monthly_sessions.numerator: distinct sessions in the calendar-month window kept by the tier
monthly_sessions.eligibility: complete months only; the collection-start month and the current month are labelled partial
monthly_sessions.window: [first of month, first of next month)
monthly_sessions.n_a: partial month -> labelled partial and never compared with a complete month

article_sessions.label: Article sessions
article_sessions.numerator: monthly sessions (same tier) with at least one pageview on an article path

post_sessions_first_7d_and_28d.label: Per-post sessions in the first 7 and 28 days
post_sessions_first_7d_and_28d.numerator: distinct sessions with at least one pageview on the post path in the window, kept by the tier
post_sessions_first_7d_and_28d.denominator: one post; cohort statistics are n, median, P25, P75, P90, max, sum, mean, share zero
post_sessions_first_7d_and_28d.eligibility: launch on or after the property's collection start and the window fully observed; a 7-day versus 28-day comparison uses one paired cohort in which both windows are observed
post_sessions_first_7d_and_28d.n_a: window not fully observed -> post excluded, never counted as 0

search_referred_sessions.label: Search-referred sessions
search_referred_sessions.numerator: distinct sessions with at least one pageview whose referrer domain is a listed search engine
search_referred_sessions.denominator: none (count); the per-article form follows post_sessions_first_7d_and_28d
search_referred_sessions.eligibility: as the window it is reported over
search_referred_sessions.window: as reported (week, month or per-post window)

llm_referred_sessions.label: LLM-assistant-referred sessions
llm_referred_sessions.numerator: as search_referred_sessions with the LLM-assistant list

referral_arrivals_per_verified_placement.label: Referral arrivals per verified placement
referral_arrivals_per_verified_placement.numerator: distinct headline sessions that land on the placed article path carrying the placement's own tag (or the placement URL as referrer where the platform passes it)
referral_arrivals_per_verified_placement.eligibility: the placement has a publication receipt (URL and timestamp) and its surface is tagged on or before the placement date
referral_arrivals_per_verified_placement.n_a: no receipt -> unverified placement; untagged surface -> untagged - unmeasurable; neither is 0
referral_arrivals_per_verified_placement.never: compared with per-post session counts (different denominator)

weekly_site_sessions.label: Site sessions this week (raw)
weekly_site_sessions.numerator: distinct Umami sessions recorded for the site's property and hostname in the window
weekly_site_sessions.eligibility: every reported site in the installed analytics registry
weekly_site_sessions.window: [report date - 7 days, report date) in the report clock
weekly_site_sessions.n_a: query failure -> the whole report refuses; no site row is dropped or zero-filled

weekly_site_pageviews.label: Site pageviews this week (raw)
weekly_site_pageviews.numerator: pageviews recorded for the site's property and hostname in the window

weekly_filtered_sessions.label: Site sessions this week with suspected automation removed
weekly_filtered_sessions.numerator: distinct sessions in the week window not removed by the rule (window-level classification)
weekly_filtered_sessions.denominator: none (count); companion 'removed share' = 1 - filtered / raw sessions, same window
weekly_filtered_sessions.window: week and prior week, as weekly_site_sessions
weekly_filtered_sessions.filter_version: rule version printed in the report (automation_rule.version)

weekly_change.label: Change against the comparison window (WoW, MoM, YoY)
weekly_change.unit: percent change of the same metric
weekly_change.numerator: current window value minus comparison window value
weekly_change.denominator: comparison window value of the same metric, same site set, same filter
weekly_change.eligibility: the comparison_rule above: both windows fully observed for the whole population; the comparison window starts on or after the population's verified complete-since date
weekly_change.window: WoW: prior 7 days; MoM: prior month to the same day; YoY: same span one year earlier
weekly_change.n_a: comparison window not fully observed, population changed, or comparison value 0 -> n/a with the reason, never a percentage

portfolio_fixed_cohort_sessions.label: Fixed-cohort portfolio sessions (sum of site sessions)
portfolio_fixed_cohort_sessions.unit: session summed across sites (not distinct people across sites)
portfolio_fixed_cohort_sessions.numerator: sum of site sessions over the fixed cohort's member sites
portfolio_fixed_cohort_sessions.eligibility: fixed cohort membership from the traffic rule; complete since the cohort's complete_since date

portfolio_all_registry_sessions.label: All-registry total (sum of every reported site)
portfolio_all_registry_sessions.numerator: sum of site sessions over every reported registry site
portfolio_all_registry_sessions.eligibility: levels only; comparisons need both windows on or after the registry's complete-since date (2026-09-24)
portfolio_all_registry_sessions.n_a: comparison across the registry growth date -> n/a

weekly_referral_arrivals.label: Referral arrivals by surface (startaitools.com)
weekly_referral_arrivals.numerator: distinct week sessions that arrived with the surface's tag, a known referrer domain, or the surface's marker; one session counts once per surface
weekly_referral_arrivals.eligibility: surfaces listed in the traffic rule; tagged arrivals only for surfaces tagged since a date inside or before the window
weekly_referral_arrivals.filter_version: rule version printed in the report; filtered first, raw in brackets
weekly_referral_arrivals.n_a: query failure -> unavailable; untagged surface -> untagged - unmeasurable; never 0
weekly_referral_arrivals.never: evidence that a post was or was not made

devto_native_page_views.label: Dev.to page views (native, platform-reported)
devto_native_page_views.numerator: sum over Dev.to articles of page_views in the latest successful observation; the weekly delta is latest minus the observation at least 7 days earlier, per article present in both
devto_native_page_views.eligibility: articles present in a successful observation; deltas only for articles present in both observations
devto_native_page_views.window: point in time (latest observation) and observation-to-observation delta
devto_native_page_views.n_a: no successful observation -> unavailable; no observation 7 or more days older -> delta n/a; a null field is unknown, never 0
devto_native_page_views.never: added to, compared with, or divided by site sessions

devto_native_reactions_comments.label: Dev.to reactions and comments (native)
devto_native_reactions_comments.numerator: sum over articles in the latest successful observation

native_surfaces_without_collector.label: Native reads on surfaces without a collector (Hashnode, Substack, Medium, LinkedIn, X)
native_surfaces_without_collector.eligibility: every surface in the collector registry whose status is not 'collected'
native_surfaces_without_collector.n_a: always reported as unknown with the registry reason; never 0 readers
